race.description: The Agency Real Estate St Leger Stakes (G3)
race.comment: BELLA MONTAGNA (12) comes here fourth up and gets one more chance with the blinkers coming off on a rain affected track. Eased late in betting when no match for SO YOU ARE in the small field over 2400m in the G3 Colin Stephen Qlty at Rosehill. Looks the value play on the limit weight with Tim Clark keeping the ride. SO YOU ARE (4) is in great form and faces his toughest test to date.  Took control in the small field and pulled out plenty to score over 2400m in the G3 Colin Stephen Quality at Rosehill. Finds a bit more pressure today but gets the economical run from the draw. Each way. PIGGYBACK (7) no excuses today fifth up after running eighth over 2520m at Flemington in the G3 Bart Cummings on a heavy track. Can return to form. KLONDIKE (3) caught the eye first up and comes to hand quickly. SAM HAWKENS (9) races best on rain affected tracks and gets another chance fourth up. Proven at the trip and goes into the exotics.
